mapper.sql: select r.id, r.tour_id as tourId, t.name as tourName, r.order_id as orderId, r.customer_user_id as customerUserId, r.nickname, r.avatar, r.title, r.content, r.rating, r.source, r.status, r.featured, r.sort_order as sortOrder, r.published_at as publishedAt, r.reject_reason as rejectReason, r.create_time as createTime, r.update_time as updateTime from holidays_review r left join holidays_tour t on t.id = r.tour_id
mapper.select: select avg(rating) from holidays_review where tour_id = #{tourId} and status = 1
